sections.basis: Reuse only the currently adopted DEU/POL LSIB-derived arcs; estuary and remaining Neisse are held.
Current adopted German linework, Saxony exterior only; Bavaria is outside the DDR ring.

Lake-crossing arcs between existing geometric intersections only. Former inter-German boundary equals current SH/MV boundary within Schaalsee per the reserve authority; surrounding land is excluded. Official SH lake catchment map (1:50000) reviewed for the lake passage; no independent historical vector accuracy claim. The old NE path detours south to 53.548463; the window includes this obsolete detour, while the replacement lake arc stays north of 53.5716795 between actual shared intersections.

Bavarian survey authority exhibition catalogue, printed p.3 (PDF p.9), explicitly identifies the 1973 commission markers as the present 422 km Bavaria/Saxony/Thuringia boundary. Falkenstein 1949 adjustment and 1957/1980 aerial boundary illustrations reviewed. Conservative window excludes the Hessian corner and Czech exterior; no independent period-vector positional accuracy claim.

Bavarian survey continuity statement corroborated by Saxon Green Belt regulation identifying the former DDR border strip along the Saxony/Bavaria land boundary. Southern cutoff excludes the Czech tripoint; existing LSIB exterior remains unchanged.

Niedersachsen political education authority, Das Eichsfeld (2002), printed p.17/PDF p.18 explicitly records the former state border becoming the Niedersachsen/Hessen-Thuringia land boundary on 1990-10-03. Only the northern Eichsfeld interval is admitted; southern Wendebach and unreviewed Werra intervals excluded.

Nationalpark Harz, Gewaesser im Nationalpark Harz, PDF p.29: the Ecker from source to Harz foothills is the current state boundary and was the DDR/BRD boundary until reunification. LGLN NaVKV 2/3 2010, printed p.41, independently documents the reservoir/dam boundary and retained marker. Restricted Ecker/reservoir interval, not all Harz.

Official Geismar land-reorganisation plan, maps PDF pp.1-3 (1:5000, dated 2015-12-09) and text PDF p.30/printed p.10 identify the former border strip along its western edge adjoining Hessen. The western state boundary is distinguished from the internal Kolonnenweg. Restricted Geismar/Spahl/Roedgen interval, south of Point Alpha; corroborated by the federal Green Belt explanation of the former strip between land boundary and Kolonnenweg. Visual/documentary continuity only, not a digitized 1989 positional test.

held: Amt Neuhaus, Neu Bleckede, Neu Wendischthun, Stiepelse and Bohldamm transferred areas
Northern SH/MV land sectors around Schaalsee; Altmark/Ohre and remaining Harz sectors without segment-specific corroboration
Hessian/Thuringian Werra, southern Eichsfeld/Wendebach and Rhon/Geisa outside the admitted windows
Bavarian west/Rhon and Czech-tripoint transition gaps outside conservative crossing-to-crossing windows; west window yielded no admissible intersecting arc
West Berlin and coast (out of scope)
Polish/Czech exterior outside the currently adopted LSIB crossing-to-crossing arcs
